cohort: The study included 1013 G6PD-deficient neonates identified from 40,305 total births at Al Wakra Hospital between January 2015 and September 2022.
finding: Among G6PDD babies, 24.6% received phototherapy, and gestational age group was found to be significantly associated with the need for phototherapy in logistic regression analysis.
